verdict.rationale: The only evidence of a desktop client is community comment: one user describes Google's own 'sync to local' software on the Mac as unreliable, saying synced items are often just URLs with no downloaded content (comm-4), and another notes there is no Linux desktop support (comm-3). No first-party documentation covers the desktop clients, and the evidence pack is entirely about the API. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of official macOS/Windows desktop clients, any evidence of a Windows client, selective sync, on-demand/online-only files, and evidence that sync works reliably.
